Check the event sign-up list available to you and confirm the current attendance count. Use that count to set aside one map and one scorecard per attendee; for example, a confirmed count of N attendees requires N maps and N scorecards.

Recheck attendance immediately before assembly, since the final count may change. Adjust the material quantities to match the updated count, then assemble one kit per attendee, with one map and one scorecard in each kit.

Count the completed kits and check their contents, then place them on the welcome table before doors open. Leave enough time for these final checks. If attendance changes after assembly, add or set aside kits as needed so the table matches the latest confirmed count.
